feat: remove features.mcp-cli flag, rename mount-as-clis to cli-proxy (#28842)

* feat: remove features.mcp-cli flag, rename mount-as-clis to cli-proxy

- Remove MCPCLIFeatureFlag from constants; MCP CLI mounting is now always
  active when tools.cli-proxy: true is set (no feature flag needed)
- Rename tools.mount-as-clis → tools.cli-proxy in ToolsConfig, parser,
  schema, and all workflow .md files
- Remove alwaysCLIMountedServers: safeoutputs and mcpscripts are no longer
  auto-mounted; they are only mounted when cli-proxy: true is set
- Simplify getMCPCLIExcludeFromAgentConfig (no more dual-access exclusion)
- Update all test files to use CLIProxy field and remove MCPCLIFeatureFlag
- Remove mcp-cli: true from 60+ workflow features blocks
- Recompile all lock files
